mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(record_date, '%Y-%m') AS monthDimension, AVG(avg_temp) AS avgTemp, AVG(daily_range) AS avgDailyRange, MAX(season) AS season FROM weather_dwd GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(record_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY monthDimension ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(record_date, '%Y-%m') AS monthDimension, AVG(daily_range) AS avgDailyRange, MAX(daily_range) AS maxDailyRange, MIN(daily_range) AS minDailyRange, STDDEV(daily_range) AS stdDailyRange FROM weather_dwd GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(record_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY monthDimension ASC

SELECT season, AVG(daily_range) AS avgDailyRange, MAX(daily_range) AS maxDailyRange, MIN(daily_range) AS minDailyRange, AVG(CASE WHEN pct BETWEEN 0.24 AND 0.26 THEN daily_range END) AS q1, AVG(CASE WHEN pct BETWEEN 0.49 AND 0.51 THEN daily_range END) AS median, AVG(CASE WHEN pct BETWEEN 0.74 AND 0.76 THEN daily_range END) AS q3 FROM ( SELECT season, daily_range, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY season ORDER BY daily_range) AS pct FROM weather_dwd ) ranked GROUP BY season ORDER BY FIELD(season, '春', '夏', '秋', '冬')
